summary: The plan is close, but it has an incomplete warning propagation path, contradictory T8 coverage, and unmapped/out-of-scope bookkeeping.

findings.title: T2 drops next warnings on the archive path
findings.detail: T2 propagates warnings only through cmd_next.go and launch.go, but a post-lock next can call nextRun.archive, whose stop op is constructed in archive.go. archive.go is absent from T2's scope, so an info/exclude failure can still disappear from successful next JSON. Include and test this path or centralize all post-lock op output through a warning-aware helper.

findings.title: T8 has contradictory and insufficient caller coverage
findings.detail: T8 first requires coverage of only one caller per file, then says all four callers need individual tests. The lint and grep checks prove only that an error result is syntactically consumed, not that each command emits warnings. Require warning-output tests for all four callers. Also, replacing events.jsonl with a directory exercises ReadEvents failure, not the specified AppendEvent failure; use a deterministic append-failure setup or seam.

findings.title: T3 claims G12 without performing the required #9 bookkeeping
findings.detail: The spec says issue #9 is closed as part of this run, but the plan leaves that action outside the task graph. T3 merely declares G12 and has no action or verification for closure, so every task can pass while the requirement remains undone.

findings.title: The plan widens scope to issue #19
findings.detail: The bookkeeping section and T3 introduce closing issue #19, which is absent from the spec's in-scope list. This outward-facing action must be removed from this plan.

findings.title: T2 leaves gitignore negation escaping ambiguous
findings.detail: T2 says the escaper must escape a leading ! and that both rules pass through it, but the second rule's leading ! is required negation syntax. Specify that the literal relative path is escaped before the syntactic ! prefix is added, and behaviorally verify that log payloads are ignored while logs/.gitignore is re-included.
